overall_notes: The paper presents SEA-GUIDE, a novel decoding method for data-to-text NLG that uses cross-attention mechanisms to improve semantic accuracy. The extraction was generally accurate but needed some normalization and removal of incidental mentions (like GPT-2). The human evaluation was focused on validating their automated slot aligner rather than directly evaluating output quality.
